pairs.target: dìèrtiān shùn gǔ wǎng xià , tǎ wéi zhōngyú kànjiàn nà dào àn hú de jiǎo .
pairs.english: Descending the valley the next day, Tavi finally saw the dark arc's feet.
pairs.hanzi: 第二天顺谷往下，塔维终于看见那道暗弧的脚。

pairs.target: búshì yìgēn zhùzi .
pairs.english: It was not one pillar.
pairs.hanzi: 不是一根柱子。

pairs.target: liǎng pō gè yǒu jǐcéng kuāndà de shízuò , qiánhòu cuòkāi , jiù jià cóng zuìgāo yìcéng tànchūlái , yuèguò gǔdì , yòu zài duìmiàn zuānjìn shānbì .
pairs.english: Both slopes had tiers of broad stone bases, staggered, the old frame reaching from the highest tier across the valley into the opposite rock face.
pairs.hanzi: 两坡各有几层宽大的石座，前后错开，旧架从最高一层探出来，越过谷地，又在对面钻进山壁。

pairs.target: dǐxià bù kōng , fángzi , péng láng hé zhǎi jiē yìcéngcéng tiēzhe shízuò cháng chūlái , liàng bù cóng yìbiān guàdào lìngyìbiān , fēng qǐ shí , hǎoxiàng zhěngzuò zhènzǐ dōu zài huànyīfu .
pairs.english: Below wasn't empty: houses, covered galleries and narrow streets grew in layers against the bases, drying cloth hung across, the whole town seeming to change clothes when wind rose.
pairs.hanzi: 底下不空，房子、棚廊和窄街一层层贴着石座长出来，晾布从一边挂到另一边，风起时，好像整座镇子都在换衣服。

pairs.target: tā táitóu kàn dé tàijiǔ , chēlún yì diān , xiàbā pèngdào le xiāng gài .
pairs.english: He stared up so long a jolt knocked his chin against a case lid.
pairs.hanzi: 他抬头看得太久，车轮一颠，下巴碰到了箱盖。

pairs.target: luó dí xiào tā , zìjǐ què yě yǎng zhe tóu , shuō jīntiān fēng hǎo , shàngtóu nà jǐgēn jiù héngtiáo huì xiǎng .
pairs.english: Luodi laughed, but looked up too: today's wind would make the old crossbars sound.
pairs.hanzi: 罗荻笑他，自己却也仰着头，说今天风好，上头那几根旧横条会响。

pairs.target: guǒrán , yǒu yìshēng jí dī de chángyīn cóng gāochù lüèguò qù , xiàng yuǎnyuǎn chuī qǐ de guǎnzǐ .
pairs.english: A deep sustained note swept overhead, like a distant pipe.
pairs.hanzi: 果然，有一声极低的长音从高处掠过去，像远远吹起的管子。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bèishàng jǐn le yíxià , ruǎn héng què méi qù mō qìjù , zhī jiào tā kàn dǐngshàng de fēng shéng .
pairs.english: Tavi stiffened, but Ruanheng didn't reach for apparatus; he told him to look at the wind cord above.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维背上紧了一下，阮衡却没去摸器具，只叫他看顶上的风绳。

pairs.target: shéng wěi yìzhí xiàng tóng yícè zhāng zhe , xiàmiàn màicài de rén hái zài jiǎngjià , méi shuí táitóu .
pairs.english: The cord end was streaming steadily one way; vegetable sellers still bargained below, nobody looking up.
pairs.hanzi: 绳尾一直向同一侧张着，下面卖菜的人还在讲价，没谁抬头。

pairs.target: nà shēngyīn búshì wèi tāmen lái de .
pairs.english: The sound wasn't for them.
pairs.hanzi: 那声音不是为他们来的。

pairs.target: jìnrù zhèn kǒu , chē xiān zài lùpái biān tíng .
pairs.english: At the town entrance the cart stopped by a sign.
pairs.hanzi: 进入镇口，车先在路牌边停。

pairs.target: yù hé qù duì zhùchù , ruǎn héng tóng lái jiē de shū yàn shuō jiǎnchá ānpái , luó dí zé gé zhe jiē hǎn yígè tuīchē de rén , jiāng zìjǐ de bāo dìgěi duìfāng .
pairs.english: Yuhe checked lodging, Ruanheng discussed inspections with Shuyan, there to meet them, and Luodi called across to a man pushing a cart and handed over his bag.
pairs.hanzi: 郁禾去对住处，阮衡同来接的舒砚说检查安排，罗荻则隔着街喊一个推车的人，将自己的包递给对方。

pairs.target: nà shì tā tángxiōng , zhī bāng sòng huíjiā , bú tì suǒ lǐ bān qìjù xiāng .
pairs.english: His cousin would take the bag home, not carry office cases.
pairs.hanzi: 那是他堂兄，只帮送回家，不替所里搬器具箱。

pairs.target: yù hé diǎntóu , xiān jiāng liǎngjiàn gōngwù cóng bāo biān chōuhuí , cái fàng tā guòqù shuōhuà .
pairs.english: Yuhe nodded, reclaiming two office items beside it before letting him chat.
pairs.hanzi: 郁禾点头，先将两件公物从包边抽回，才放他过去说话。

pairs.target: shū yàn guǎn zhè jǐchù gòng lù de lái jiàn hé zhàng , búshì zhènshàng de měijiànshì dōu yóu tā shuōlesuàn .
pairs.english: Shuyan handled shared-road documents and accounts, not all town decisions.
pairs.hanzi: 舒砚管这几处共路的来件和账，不是镇上的每件事都由她说了算。

pairs.target: tā shuō kuài dào chūn shì , shàngtóu mài shānhuò de rén huì xiàlái , xiàmiàn yùn bù de yě yào guò , dé zǎoxiē kànqīng huòchē néng zài nǎér zhuǎn , bùrán yìdǔ jiù yǒurén mà jiàzi dǐxià zhī rèn dàchē de qián .
pairs.english: She said the spring market was near: mountain produce sellers descending, cloth carriers passing below. They needed to find cart turning space before a jam prompted accusations that the arch favored big-cart money.
pairs.hanzi: 她说快到春市，上头卖山货的人会下来，下面运布的也要过，得早些看清货车能在哪儿转，不然一堵就有人骂架子底下只认大车的钱。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng wèn shíjì zuì jǐ shì nǎ yíduàn .
pairs.english: Ruanheng asked which stretch was actually busiest.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡问实际最挤是哪一段。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu zhǐ tú , xiān dài tāmen zhàn dào jiēkǒu děng le yíhuìer .
pairs.english: Instead of pointing at a map, she took them to wait at the street mouth.
pairs.hanzi: 她没有指图，先带他们站到街口等了一会儿。

pairs.target: yíliàng kōngchē zhuǎnguò lái , chēwěi jīhū pèngdào wūqián de pén .
pairs.english: An empty cart turned, its tail nearly hitting a basin outside a house.
pairs.hanzi: 一辆空车转过来，车尾几乎碰到屋前的盆。

pairs.target: mén lǐ de rén gǎnjǐn bǎ pén shōujìnqù , hòumiàn bēilǒu de fùrén què méiyǒu tuì dào yuànlǐ , yìshǒu ànzhe lǒu , dīngzhù gǎnchē de rén .
pairs.english: Someone pulled the basin in, but a woman carrying a basket didn't retreat into the yard; she held it, watching the driver.
pairs.hanzi: 门里的人赶紧把盆收进去，后面背篓的妇人却没有退到院里，一手按着篓，盯住赶车的人。

pairs.target: chē guò , tā cái cóng yuánlái de dìfāng jìxù zǒu , jiǎoxià nàtiáo zhǎi shí yán bèi cǎidé hěn liàng .
pairs.english: After the cart passed she continued from her spot along a narrow stone edge worn shiny by feet.
pairs.hanzi: 车过，她才从原来的地方继续走，脚下那条窄石沿被踩得很亮。

pairs.target: shū yàn shuō tā měitiān zǒu sìtàng , búshì gǎnjí cái duō chūlái de rén .
pairs.english: Shuyan said she made four trips daily, not an extra market visitor.
pairs.hanzi: 舒砚说她每天走四趟，不是赶集才多出来的人。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wǎng zhǐ shàng jì , gāng yào xiě jiē zhǎi , fāxiàn nà liǎnggè zì hái búgòu .
pairs.english: Tavi wrote, then found those words “narrow street” insufficient.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维往纸上记，刚要写街窄，发现那两个字还不够。

pairs.target: chē quèshí zhuǎn dé guò , rén yě quèshí yào zǒu , nándào yíjù jiē zhǎi , jiù néng tì shuí xiān bǎ lìng yígè gǎn diào .
pairs.english: The cart could turn and people needed passage; calling the street narrow couldn't simply evict one for the other.
pairs.hanzi: 车确实转得过，人也确实要走，难道一句街窄，就能替谁先把另一个赶掉。

pairs.target: zhùchù zài xiàcéng gǒng dàopáng , chuāngwài néng kànjiàn yíduàn jiù lán , lán hòu gé zhe bùnéng jìn de jiǎnxiū dào , yuǎnchù cái shì shàngtóu fēng zhe de cháng kuà .
pairs.english: Their lodging stood by the lower archway, old railing outside, then a closed maintenance path separating it from the sealed upper span farther away.
pairs.hanzi: 住处在下层拱道旁，窗外能看见一段旧栏，栏后隔着不能进的检修道，远处才是上头封着的长跨。

pairs.target: kèzhàn zhǎngguì zhǐ gěi tāmen kàn rìcháng néng zǒu de dēng lù , dīngzhǔ wǎnshàng bié gēnzhe biérén suíkǒu shuō de jiéjìng qù zuàn mén .
pairs.english: The innkeeper pointed out to them lit everyday routes, warning against casually recommended shortcuts through doors at night.
pairs.hanzi: 客栈掌柜指给他们看日常能走的灯路，叮嘱晚上别跟着别人随口说的捷径去钻门。

pairs.target: tā shuō dé hěnkuài , zhuǎnshēn jiù qù jiào chúfáng tiānfàn , méiyǒu tíngxiàlái děng tāmen gǎntàn zhè dìfāng duō dà .
pairs.english: She spoke quickly, then turned to order more kitchen food without waiting for their amazement at the place's size.
pairs.hanzi: 她说得很快，转身就去叫厨房添饭，没有停下来等他们感叹这地方多大。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ bāofàng hǎo , kāichuāng shí , wéndào yízhèn kǎo lìzǐ de xiāng .
pairs.english: Settling his bag, Tavi opened the window to roasted chestnut smells.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把包放好，开窗时，闻到一阵烤栗子的香。

pairs.target: dǐxià yǒu xiǎohái ná chánggān gǎn wūyán shàng de niǎo , gǎn le zhèbiān , niǎo yòu luòdào duìmiàn , chǎo dé línjiā kāichuāng jiào tā bié gǎn le , niǎo méi zǒu , rén xiān fánsǐ .
pairs.english: Below, a child chased roof birds with a pole; they flew across, until a neighbor shouted to stop: the birds stayed, people were fed up first.
pairs.hanzi: 底下有小孩拿长杆赶屋檐上的鸟，赶了这边，鸟又落到对面，吵得邻家开窗叫他别赶了，鸟没走，人先烦死。

pairs.target: tā xiào qǐlái , hūrán méi nàme pà nà shēng gāochù de chángmíng .
pairs.english: He laughed, less afraid of the high note.
pairs.hanzi: 他笑起来，忽然没那么怕那声高处的长鸣。

pairs.target: xiàwǔ zhī zuò jiāojiē hé qìjù ānfàng , bù jí zhe kāigōng .
pairs.english: The afternoon was for handover and equipment storage, not rushing to work.
pairs.hanzi: 下午只做交接和器具安放，不急着开工。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng kànguò hòuyuàn dúlì de mù tái hé diànjiǎo , jiào zhǎngguì bié jiāng nà tái yǔ pángbiān jiù tiějià lián zhe yòng .
pairs.english: Ruanheng checked the independent wooden bench and feet in the yard, telling the innkeeper not to connect it with the old iron frame nearby.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡看过后院独立的木台和垫脚，叫掌柜别将那台与旁边旧铁架连着用。

pairs.target: liǎngtào dōngxī fēnqīng hòu , xiāngzǐ cái dǎkāi , yǐ pèi hǎo de xiǎo tiě réng zài zìjǐ de gélǐ , méiyǒu shuí yào ná zhènshàng de dà jiàzi lái tì tāmen còu yíduì .
pairs.english: Only once separated were the cases opened; the matched small iron stayed in its own compartments, nobody pairing it with the town's giant frame.
pairs.hanzi: 两套东西分清后，箱子才打开，已配好的小铁仍在自己的格里，没有谁要拿镇上的大架子来替它们凑一对。

pairs.target: luó dí huílái de wǎn , dài le liǎngzhī jiālǐ zhǔ de dàn , shuō tángxiōng dézhī tā kào bǎngshéng yíng le bái jiē xuéshēng , jiānchí duō sāi yìzhī , ràng tā bié xiàhuí jiù shū huíqù .
pairs.english: Luodi returned late with two home-boiled eggs: hearing he had beaten a White Steps student at knots, his cousin had added one so he wouldn't lose next time.
pairs.hanzi: 罗荻回来得晚，带了两只家里煮的蛋，说堂兄得知他靠绑绳赢了白阶学生，坚持多塞一只，让他别下回就输回去。

pairs.target: tā bǎ dàn fàngdào tǎ wéi miànqián , wèn hái bǐ bu bǐ .
pairs.english: He offered Tavi the eggs: another match?
pairs.hanzi: 他把蛋放到塔维面前，问还比不比。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō bǐ , búguò jīntiān xiān chī dàn , shūyíng míngtiān zàishuō .
pairs.english: Tavi agreed, but eggs first, victory tomorrow.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说比，不过今天先吃蛋，输赢明天再说。

pairs.target: luó dí xián tā lài , bāoké què bǐ shuí dōu kuài .
pairs.english: Luodi accused him of dodging, yet peeled faster than anyone.
pairs.hanzi: 罗荻嫌他赖，剥壳却比谁都快。

pairs.target: bàngwǎn tāmen qù kàn míngrì de gōngzuò dì , jīngguò nàwèi bēilǒu fùrén zhàn guò de dìfāng .
pairs.english: At dusk they visited tomorrow's worksite, passing where the basket woman had stood.
pairs.hanzi: 傍晚他们去看明日的工作地，经过那位背篓妇人站过的地方。

pairs.target: tā yǐjīng bú zài , shí yán hái liàng zhe , pángbiān duō le yìbǎ méi rén shōu de sàozhou .
pairs.english: She was gone, the stone edge still shiny, a forgotten broom beside it.
pairs.hanzi: 她已经不在，石沿还亮着，旁边多了一把没人收的扫帚。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi táitóu , jùdà de jiù hú cóng jiēshàng fāng lüèguò qù , xī guāng zhī zhàoliàng yícè , lìngyícè hēi dé xiàng néng yìzhí tōng dào hěn yuǎn de dìfāng .
pairs.english: Tavi looked up: the giant old arc swept over the street, evening light on one side, the other dark as a passage far away.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维抬头，巨大的旧弧从街上方掠过去，夕光只照亮一侧，另一侧黑得像能一直通到很远的地方。

pairs.target: tā zǒu le jǐbù , réng méi zǒuchū tā de yǐngzi .
pairs.english: Several steps later, he still hadn't left its shadow.
pairs.hanzi: 他走了几步，仍没走出它的影子。
